---
format: html
css: styles.css
resources:
  - visualization/data/bubble_with_descriptions.json
  - visualization/data/sentiment_blocks.json
  - visualization/details/**
  - visualization/bubble_bounce_hover.js
  - visualization/sentiment_block_plot.js
  - visualization/block_timeline_sentiment.js
javascripts:
  - visualization/bubble_bounce_hover.js
  - visualization/sentiment_block_plot.js
  - scripts/scroll.js
  - https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega@5.20.2/build/vega.min.js
  - https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-lite@5.6.0/build/vega-lite.min.js
  - https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-embed@6.19.0/build/vega-embed.min.js
---


<div id="bounce-bubble" style="position: relative;"></div>

<div id="hover-info-bubble" style="
  position: absolute;
  top: 40px;
  right: 40px;
  width: 240px;
  background: white;
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  font-family: sans-serif;
  font-size: 14px;
  display: none;
  z-index: 999;
"></div>

<script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js"></script>
<script type="module">
  import { drawPackedBubbleAnimated } from "./visualization/bubble_bounce_hover.js";
  drawPackedBubbleAnimated("#bounce-bubble", "visualization/data/bubble_with_descriptions.json");
</script>

---

<div id="sentiment-block" style="position: relative;"></div>

<div id="hover-info-timeline" style="
  position: absolute;
  background: white;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
  padding: 10px;
  font-size: 14px;
  max-width: 280px;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  border-radius: 6px;
  z-index: 10;
  display: none;
"></div>

<script type="module">
  import { drawSentimentBlockPlot } from "./visualization/sentiment_block_plot.js";
  drawSentimentBlockPlot("#sentiment-block", "visualization/data/sentiment_blocks.json");
</script>
